name: Glycolysis + gluconeogenesis
summary: Both directions on one diagram. Shared, reversible steps are drawn once; the gluconeogenic bypasses (pyruvate carboxylase + PEPCK, fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase, glucose-6-phosphatase) curve alongside the three irreversible glycolytic steps they get around. Reciprocal regulation: fructose-2,6-bisphosphate activates PFK-1 and inhibits F-1,6-BPase; insulin favors glycolysis, glucagon gluconeogenesis.
